snippet.title: A full wave, start to finish, on the new build | I'm Wizard 1.1.27 on Apple Vision Pro
snippet.description:
Get I'm Wizard: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/im-wizard-ar-magic-combat/id6747723768

One wave, start to finish, no cuts, recorded on device in a normal room. 

Everything new in 1.1.27, in roughly the order you see it in this video.

LIGHT ON YOUR REAL ROOM
The room used to stay dark while you fought in it. Now the ball in your fist lights your wall in its own colour, every shot drags light across your furniture, a clap floods the whole shield sphere, and bomb blasts, perk detonations, familiars and lava pools light the floor around them. Until visionOS 27 no game could put light on your passthrough at all, which is why this update requires it.

PORTALS
A portal used to be a black disc on your wall. Now it is a hole you can look into, with space behind it, and that is where the enemies come from: they step out through the window, half the body in your room and half still inside. The window is exactly the size of the spinning particle ring and its edge fades softly into the wall.

VOID ZONES
Lava used to be a flat stamped disc that the edge of a table cut in half. Now it is a rounded pool with volume and a living outline that drifts and stretches in the direction it moves, it pours down the edge of real furniture instead of sinking into it, and the damage is computed from the shape you actually see.

THE FIRST FIVE WAVES
The tutorial sandbox is gone. New players learn on the real waves 1 to 5, one gesture per wave, keeping the experience and perks they earn, and dying in those waves restarts the same wave instead of ending the run. If you stopped before wave 6, the game asks you to run it once. Talents, experience and records stay where they are.

FIXES YOU WILL FEEL
No more freeze on your first kill after launch. Enemies no longer step out of a portal twice. Mana crystals and projectiles no longer disappear behind furniture. The ring on the Wave Done panel no longer breaks at its corners.

WHAT HAS NOT CHANGED
Balance. Same 20 wave campaign, same 18 perks in Endless Mode, same enemies and talents. This release went entirely into how the game sits in your room.

I'm Wizard is an AR magic combat game for Apple Vision Pro. You cast with your hands, dodge with your body, and fight waves of enemies that come through portals on your real walls. Four of us make it.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/im-wizard-ar-magic-combat/id6747723768
Website: https://iwizard.app/
